name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 3.8 degrees north of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 23 times in 8 visits over 80 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 48 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 3.3 days starting 2026-06-04, at wavelengths from 0.75 to 4.53 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
